task: Determine which exact revision is serving this synthetic candidate and whether the runtime qualifies for exact-head review. Read the supplied artifacts only. Return one JSON object using the response fields.

artifacts.policy: Match the checked-out SHA with build provenance, the actual service image, and the web-to-API response. Health or a label alone cannot prove identity.

responseFields.observedRevision: Exact revision seen in both running-service observations.
responseFields.identity: One of verified, mismatch, or unknown.
responseFields.nextAction: One of accept-evidence, reconcile-and-reverify, or reuse-health-only.
